notesStmt.note: As this seems to be an early draft, it was likely written in 1882 or early 1883.

This manuscript is an early draft of the first part of the essay "The Bible as Poetry," published in the Critic on February 3, 1883, and then included, with revisions but under the same title, in November Boughs (1888).
